finding: 10 critical camera I2C control, clock (MCLK), and power-down (PWDN) nets are disconnected or unrouted, rendering stereo cameras completely inoperable.
rule_violated: JLCPCB Target: 0 unconnected items; IPC-2221 §6.3 Electrical Connectivity
root_cause: Incomplete routing between Jetson SoM connector J15, pull-up resistors, and dual MIPI CSI camera connectors CAM_L / CAM_R.
proposed_fix: Route CAM0_SDA, CAM0_SCL, CAM1_SDA, CAM1_SCL, CAM0_PWDN, CAM0_MCLK, and CAM1_MCLK using 0.20 mm tracks on In3_SIGNAL.Cu / B.Cu with standard 0.45/0.20 mm vias.
rationale: High-speed camera MCLK (24 MHz) and I2C signals require uninterrupted reference return paths and low parasitic resistance.
side_effects: Refill copper zones across all 8 layers and re-run DRC to confirm zero clearance regressions.

location: Board-wide (J15, J13, J22, IC17, D2, D4)
finding: 247 schematic-to-PCB parity discrepancies including pad net assignments (PCIe, Ethernet, PWR_BUTTON) and component property mismatches.
rule_violated: KiCad DRC Schematic Parity Check; JLCPCB Netlist Consistency Gate
root_cause: Schematic netlist and component attributes were updated without synchronizing PCB layout database.
proposed_fix: Synchronize PCB from schematic to reconcile all net names, pin assignments, and component properties.
rationale: Fabricated board must have 100% netlist parity with schematic to ensure electrical functionality and correct automated assembly.
side_effects: Verify no copper traces are orphaned or disconnected by net reconciliation.

finding: Board design rules violate JLCPCB minimum fabrication capability limits (annular ring 0.075 mm < 0.10 mm, hole diameter 0.15 mm < 0.20 mm, copper-to-edge 0.125 mm < 0.20 mm).
rule_violated: JLCPCB Multilayer Fabrication Constraints; Section 3 Constraint Targets
root_cause: KiCad design rules were misconfigured with sub-manufacturing thresholds that JLCPCB standard multilayer lines cannot manufacture.
proposed_fix: Update .kicad_pro design rules to meet or exceed JLCPCB multilayer targets: min_via_annular_width >= 0.10 mm (target 0.15 mm), min_copper_edge_clearance >= 0.25 mm (target 0.30 mm), min_through_hole_diameter >= 0.25 mm.
rationale: Prevents drill breakout, barrel cracking during thermal cycling, and copper exposure during perimeter milling.
side_effects: Re-run DRC against updated rules to ensure all layout geometry conforms.

finding: Minimum text height (0.65 mm) and text thickness (0.08 mm) violate JLCPCB silkscreen legibility limits (1.0 mm / 0.15 mm).
rule_violated: JLCPCB Silkscreen Line / Text Height: >= 0.15 / 1.0 mm
root_cause: Silkscreen DRC constraints were set below the minimum optical resolution of standard silkscreen screen printing.
proposed_fix: Configure min_text_height to 0.80 mm (target 1.0 mm) and min_text_thickness to 0.12 mm (target 0.15 mm).
rationale: Prevents illegible, smeared, or broken reference designators post-reflow.
side_effects: Ensure all component reference designators on PCB comply with updated constraints.

finding: 321 ERC warnings for footprint library resolution ('The current configuration does not include the footprint library jetson-footprints').
rule_violated: Section 9.3 T1 ERC: 0 errors, 0 warnings; T11 Repo hygiene
root_cause: Eeschema configuration references footprint library with local prefix without synchronized environment mapping.
proposed_fix: Configure project-local library tables and symbol definitions to resolve cleanly without configuration warnings.
rationale: A public release repository must be standalone and compile with 0 warnings on any user machine.
side_effects: Re-run kicad-cli sch erc to verify 0 warnings.

finding: 199 DRC warnings for footprint library parity ('The footprint library jetson-footprints is not enabled in the current configuration').
rule_violated: Section 9.3 T2 DRC: 0 errors, 0 warnings; T11 Repo hygiene
root_cause: KiCad 10 DRC library parity check requires project footprint library table to be enabled and synchronized with local worktree.
proposed_fix: Enable and configure jetson-footprints library table so that all footprints resolve against project-local definitions.
rationale: Eliminates false library warnings and guarantees footprint land patterns match project definitions.

location: F.SilkS and B.SilkS (97 locations across board)
finding: 97 DRC warnings for silkscreen line clearance < 0.15 mm or overlapping adjacent legends and pads.
rule_violated: JLCPCB Target: Silkscreen clearance >= 0.15 mm; IPC-7351C
root_cause: Silkscreen reference designators and graphics overlap adjacent component outlines (e.g., L4, J15, R15).
proposed_fix: Adjust silkscreen text positions and clearances to maintain >= 0.15 mm spacing from all copper pads and adjacent silk lines.
rationale: Prevents solder mask contamination and illegible printing during automated assembly.
side_effects: Verify no silkscreen is pushed onto component pads or beyond board outline.

location: Board edge near J4 (167.66 mm, 75.91 mm) and J15 (89.66 mm, 128.91 mm)
finding: 8 DRC warnings for silkscreen clipped by board edge cuts (clearance < 0.15 mm).
rule_violated: JLCPCB Target: Silkscreen to routed board edge >= 0.20 mm
root_cause: Silkscreen outlines for edge connectors J4 and J15 extend to or beyond the Edge.Cuts routing line.
proposed_fix: Pull back silkscreen graphics and text so that all silkscreen features maintain >= 0.25 mm clearance from Edge.Cuts.
rationale: Eliminates CNC router bit tearing of silkscreen legend during panel routing.
side_effects: Ensure connector pin identification remains clear after pull-back.

finding: All assembled components lack LCSC part numbers in schematic symbol fields, preventing automated JLCPCB SMT quoting and assembly.
evidence: review/trial-outputs/BOM.csv: missing LCSC values across 296 assembled parts
rule_violated: Section 9.3 T6 BOM completeness; JLCPCB PCBA SMT Ordering Standard
root_cause: LCSC part numbers were not populated during initial schematic capture.
proposed_fix: Populate valid LCSC part numbers across all passive components (0402, 0603, 1206 capacitors and resistors), semiconductors, and connectors in the BOM.
rationale: Direct LCSC part assignment eliminates assembly delays, manual part mapping errors, and non-stock surcharges.
side_effects: Verify LCSC parts match footprint land patterns and electrical ratings.

finding: Manufacturing documentation package lacks formalized JLCPCB ordering specification with complete fabrication, stackup, and assembly notes.
rule_violated: Section 10 Phase F Release Package Requirement
root_cause: Manufacturing release package has not yet been assembled.
proposed_fix: Compile manufacturing/ORDER_SPEC.md detailing PCB stackup (JLC08161H-3313), surface finish (ENIG), solder mask (green), via tenting, and PCBA assembly notes.
rationale: Enables one-click ordering on JLCPCB portal without engineering queries.

finding: Input voltage text "9...36 VDC" overlapped header J4 ground return wire, and visible unformatted MPN text on fuse F3 collided with TVS diode D14 wire corridor.
rule_violated: KiCad Schematic Conventions; Clear Wire & Text Corridor Clearance
root_cause: Component text fields placed directly on top of electrical wire segments during schematic capture.
proposed_fix: Relocate "9...36 VDC" text above J4 pin 1 and set (hide yes) on F3 MPN attribute.
rationale: Eliminates visual drafting defects and prevents misinterpretation during schematic review.

finding: Reference designator string R64 crossed the 0R jumper wire corridor feeding USB-C VBUS power rail.
rule_violated: KiCad Schematic Conventions; Section 9.3 Drawing Hygiene
root_cause: Default auto-placed reference text offset intersected horizontal wire segment.
proposed_fix: Reposition Reference R64 to (350.52, 40.0) centered in open space directly above resistor body.
rationale: Restores clean wire corridors and professional drafting presentation.

finding: 100nF decoupling capacitor C36 was connected to 3V3_SYS upstream of diode D15 rather than to EEPROM_PWR directly at IC17 VCC pin 4.
rule_violated: IPC-2221 §4.2 Bypass & Decoupling Strategy; Microchip AT24CS01 Datasheet
root_cause: Capacitor C36 was assigned to 3V3_SYS global rail before steering diode D15 instead of IC17 local power net.
proposed_fix: Connect C36 pin 1 directly to net /ID Serial/EEPROM_PWR on schematic and PCB layout.
rationale: Diode D15 isolates IC17 during EEPROM page write programming operations (~5 mA pulses); local bypass charge reservoir on EEPROM_PWR prevents rail droop and data corruption.
side_effects: Synchronize PCB netlist and re-route C36 pad 1 on B.Cu to EEPROM_PWR corridor.

finding: 100nF power supply bypass capacitor C5 for IC11 (SN74LV1T125 level translator) was marked DNP, leaving active switching buffer unbypassed on 1V8_SYS.
root_cause: Symbol attributes in schematic had (in_bom no) and (dnp yes) accidentally applied.
proposed_fix: Set C5 to (in_bom yes) and (dnp no) in schematic and remove exclude_from_bom dnp on PCB footprint.
rationale: High-speed logic transitions without local bypass capacitance cause supply rail ground bounce and clock jitter.
side_effects: Adds 1 line item (LCSC C1525) to production BOM and CPL files.

finding: C36 pad 1 was routed to 3V3_SYS via stub to D15 pad 2 instead of connecting to adjacent EEPROM_PWR copper plane.
rule_violated: IPC-2221 §6.3 Netlist Consistency Gate; Decoupling Layout Loop Inductance
root_cause: Layout followed erroneous initial netlist assignment connecting C36 to 3V3_SYS.
proposed_fix: Remove 3V3_SYS copper stubs and route C36 pad 1 with 0.125 mm trace directly to adjacent EEPROM_PWR corridor.
rationale: Provides low-inductance charge delivery loop between C36 and IC17 pin 4 on B.Cu.
side_effects: Re-run DRC to confirm 0 clearance violations and 0 unconnected items.
